columns.name: accounts_name

table.retrieve:
SELECT  
	accounts.acccode ,	
	accounts.localaccountname,
	accounts.subcode ,
	accounts.name , 
	accounts.aliasname,
	accounts.openingdate ,
	supplier.suppcode ,
	supplier.suppcatcode,
	supplier.cp ,
	supplier.address1 ,
	supplier.city ,
	supplier.country ,
	supplier.phone ,
	supplier.fax ,
	supplier.email ,
	supplier.address2,
	supplier.defaultgst,
	accounts.active,
	supplier.dayslimit,
	supplier.specialinstructions,
	supplier.countycode,
	supplier.postcode,
	supplier.ntnno,
	supplier.salestaxregno,
	supplier.CNIC ,
	supplier.MobileNo ,
	supplier.WebSiteAdd ,
	supplier.Phone2 ,
	supplier.EMAIL2 ,
	supplier.EMAIL3 ,
	supplier.BankAcc,
	supplier.whperc,
	supplier.purquotationcode,
	supplier.sitecode
FROM 
	accounts ,
	supplier     
WHERE 
	( supplier.suppcode = accounts.acccode ) and
	( ( dbo.supplier.SuppCode = :ar_supp_code ) )
